hybrid_engine: R Amelia preprocessing, bootstrap, conditional draws and postprocessing; PyTorch CPU float64 EM
validated: Importing original and hybrid interfaces does not import torch
The current Python interpreter overrides stale RETICULATE_PYTHON settings in the child R process
Ordinary bootstrap and no-bootstrap m=2 outputs agree with the original R stream within numerical tolerances
No-bootstrap replicates use distinct random draws
Categorical, ordered, log, priors and bounds interfaces agree with original R
Append preserves the selected execution engine and device/dtype
Saved RDS preserves hybrid provenance; mixed append records the new engine separately
Self-contained molist RDS multiple-overimputation workflow agrees with original R
Parallel replicate scheduling unsupported by the hybrid is explicitly rejected

rng_interoperability_fix.cause: Original Amelia C++ imputation advances internal R RNG state without updating the R-visible .Random.seed vector; reticulate scopes can reload the stale vector.
rng_interoperability_fix.implementation: Two registered C routines snapshot both states and restore internal state before separately restoring the original visible seed; no random numbers are generated by the helpers.

limitations: Cross-platform installation and accelerator tests remain separate acceptance gates.
This record does not establish a speed advantage or full original API acceptance.
